title: PenguinOS Celerity Unofficial
hello_subtitle: Changes since the previous public build. Take a look before you dive in.

highlights.title: Qualcomm QSSI LA.QSSI.17.0.r1-12400
highlights.summary: Merged the latest Qualcomm QSSI baseline with audio policy, media and Codec2 fixes.

highlights.title: Screen mirroring and casting
highlights.summary: WFD now works, and the phone stays responsive while casting.

highlights.title: Google Camera photo mode
highlights.summary: RAW10 buffers allocate correctly again, so the viewfinder and shutter work.

highlights.title: Grid previews and applying
highlights.summary: Wallpaper & style previews are correct, and 5x5/5x6 now applies immediately.

highlights.title: Dock matches the grid
highlights.summary: The bottom dock now uses the grid's hotseat count instead of staying at 4 columns.

highlights.title: NFC on the Mi 11X
highlights.summary: The non-NFC model no longer starts NFC on unsupported hardware and ANR-loops.

highlights.title: Audio stack
highlights.summary: Stock audio HAL and volume listener restored, fixing the gain-calibration loop.

highlights.title: 24-bit audio and A2DP
highlights.summary: 24-bit audio and Bluetooth A2DP offload are restored.

highlights.title: Thermal stack
highlights.summary: Stock QTI thermal map restored for correct thermal and charging behaviour.

highlights.title: Stock HIDL 2.2 perf blobs
highlights.summary: Restored the alioth perf service, HIDL 2.2 libraries, game optimization feature and 0x104A game hints.

highlights.title: Dolby in games
highlights.summary: Dolby effects stay active in games that play audio through the media stream.

highlights.title: Vanilla GApps space
highlights.summary: Vanilla builds reserve space so a GApps package can be flashed later.

highlights.title: Quick Settings and lock screen
highlights.summary: COS cascade, in-place notifications, Tall Stack clock, battery info and a data-disabled toggle.

highlights.title: Double-tap to wake
highlights.summary: Responds immediately without starting the proximity sensor first.

highlights.title: Dialer and Recents
highlights.summary: Dialer glass bars are tinted grey, and Recents memory info stays above the navigation bar.

highlights.title: Audio sharing
highlights.summary: Classic audio-sharing codec and per-device volume controls added.
